# ppds_solutions_list

List Dataverse solutions for the current environment. Shows solution name, version, publisher, and managed status. Use includeManaged to also show managed (system) solutions.

## Input schema

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| filter | `String` | no | Optional filter by solution name (friendly name or unique name) |
| includeManaged | `Boolean` | no | Include managed solutions in the results (default false) |

## Output

Returns `Task<SolutionsListResult>`.
